description: Bring a deleted page back from the trash, with the child pages that were deleted with it. Takes the page's UUID from list_trash: deleted pages can't be found by their path. If the slug was taken meanwhile the page gets a new one (slug_changed), and if its parent page is still deleted it comes back at the top level of its space (reparented_to_root).

page_id.description: UUID of the deleted page, from list_trash

name: restore_page
title: Restore page
